Are you searching for authentic power? Authentic Power is the alignment of your personality with your soul and it is a new vision of power and hope in this time of extraordinary transformation. Universal Human gives us new tools to grow spiritually and shows us how to transform everyday experiences of hopelessness, emptiness, and pain into fulfillment, meaning, and joy.

Tune in for a discussion on Moments with Marianne at KMET 1490AM & 98.1 FM ABC Talk Radio!
